name: Surfer SEO
prompt: Build a content optimization editor that accepts a target keyword, fetches top-ranking pages through a search API, extracts headings and term frequencies, suggests a brief, scores live draft coverage, flags readability issues, and saves projects in SQLite. Include export to Markdown and a transparent scoring breakdown.
notes: A transparent term-coverage tool is buildable. The durable data moat and model tuning are not.
